posts.text: Seconded, I've been pleasantly surprised by how well OpenAI is doing on transparency recently, especially all the great misalignment reports. It's raising standards for the rest of the industry!
posts.quoted: I’m biased, but OpenAI has been doing an excellent job on the transparency front. To benefit the public (at cost to itself), OpenAI has shared: - the original o1 preview results - many high quality evals - misalignment reports - and now, a history of base model training results
